requirements.text: План охватывает первые три месяца доставки на дом.
requirements.taskQuote: Write a marketing plan for the first three months.

requirements.text: Все траты, включая платную рекламу, укладываются в 3000 EUR.
requirements.taskQuote: The total budget is 3000 EUR including any paid ads.

requirements.text: Каждый канал указан со своей стоимостью и причиной, зачем он нужен.
requirements.taskQuote: Show which channels we use, what each costs and why.

requirements.text: Календарь по неделям на первый месяц и план по месяцам на второй и третий.
requirements.taskQuote: Give a week-by-week calendar for the first month and a month-by-month plan after that.

requirements.text: План говорит, как заказы относятся к каждому каналу.
requirements.taskQuote: Say how we will count orders that came from each channel.

requirements.text: Каждый текст для покупателей есть на английском и на испанском.
requirements.taskQuote: Everything customers see must exist in English and Spanish.

lenses.title: Бюджет, числа и учёт
lenses.duty: Найти каждую неверную сумму, стоимость, дату или количество, каждую трату сверх бюджета и каждый канал, заказы из которого нельзя посчитать так, как написано.
procedure: List every cost in the plan, the calendar and the budget table, and add them up per month and in total.
Compare each total with the budget in the task and with every other place the same total is stated.
Check every date and weekday of the calendar against a real calendar for the launch months.
For each channel, follow the described way of counting orders step by step and note where an order would not be attributed or would be counted twice.
Check prices and audience numbers against the primary sources and record each command.
checklist: Do the costs add up to the stated totals, and does the total stay within the budget including ads?
Is every number stated the same way in every place it appears?
Are dates and weekdays correct?
Can orders from each channel actually be counted as described (codes, link tags, questions at checkout)?
Are prices, reach and audience figures supported by a source?
Is there a rule for what to do when a channel costs more than it brings?

minimum.rule: Every line of the budget table, recomputed.
Every week of the calendar: dates, channel, cost.
Check prices and audience figures against the sources.

lenses.title: Каналы и выполнимость
lenses.duty: Найти каждый канал, действие или срок в плане, которые не сработают для маленькой пекарни в Спрингфилде с этим бюджетом и этими людьми, и каждый разрыв между планом и его заявленной целью.
procedure: Write down the goal and the audience the plan states, then list every channel with what it is expected to bring.
For each channel, check who does the work, when, with what material, and whether the timeline in the calendar allows it.
Compare the channel mix with the audience: language, district, age, how they order food today.
Read the plan for months two and three and check that each step follows from what month one is meant to show.
checklist: Does every channel have an owner, a schedule and the material it needs?
Is the channel mix right for the stated audience and languages?
Can each step be done in the time the calendar gives it?
Do months two and three depend on results that month one actually measures?
Is anything the task asks for missing from the plan?
Are there contradictions between the plan text and the calendar?

minimum.rule: Every channel: cost, owner, expected result.

lenses.title: Тексты на английском и испанском
lenses.duty: Найти каждую языковую ошибку, которую заметит носитель языка в текстах для покупателей, и каждый текст, которого нет на одном из языков или который на нём говорит другое.
procedure: List every customer-facing text in the plan, the calendar and the visuals.
For each one, find its English and its Spanish version and compare their meaning.
Read each version sentence by sentence for grammar, spelling, diacritics and natural wording.
Read the text on every visual.
checklist: Does every customer-facing text exist in both languages?
Do the two versions say the same thing, including prices and dates?
Are grammar, cases, diacritics and spelling correct?
Is the form of address the same everywhere?
Are names of products and the bakery spelled the same everywhere?

minimum.rule: Every customer-facing sentence in the plan.

lenses.title: Заявления, закон и правила площадок
lenses.duty: Найти каждое заявление для покупателей, которое неверно или ничем не подтверждено, каждое обещание, которое пекарня не сможет выполнить, и каждое противоречие закону о рекламе или правилам площадок.
procedure: List every claim the plan makes to customers: prices, delivery times, discounts, ingredients, comparisons.
Check each claim against the primary sources and the author's notes, treating the notes as hints only.
Check promotions, contests and discounts against local advertising and consumer rules and the rules of each platform used.
checklist: Is every customer-facing claim true and supported by a source?
Can the bakery keep every promise (delivery times, areas, prices)?
Do contests and discounts follow advertising and consumer rules?
Do paid ads and posts follow each platform's rules?
Are required caveats present (terms of a discount, delivery area, allergens where relevant)?

minimum.rule: Every claim in the plan text.
The author's notes in full, as claims to check.
Check delivery terms and prices against the shop source.

lenses.title: Первый читатель
lenses.duty: Прочитать всю работу как человек, у которого есть только задание владельца, и найти, где работа не даёт того, что просили, трудна для понимания или в ней нет чего-то нужного.
procedure: Read the owner's task and list everything it asks for.
Read every file of the work once, start to end.
For each thing the task asks for, find where the work delivers it, and note what is missing or only partly there.
Note everything that is confusing, contradictory or unexplained on first reading.
checklist: Is every requirement of the task delivered?
Could the owner start working from this plan tomorrow?
Do the parts of the work agree with each other?
Is anything required missing?
Is anything confusing or unexplained on first reading?

minimum.rule: Read every file once, start to end.
